items.title: Fairtex Training Center Pattaya
items.content_text: Muay Thai and BJJ centre with published drop-in, multi-session, monthly and accommodation packages.

items.title: Battle & Conquer Gym

items.title: Rambaa Somdet M16

items.title: BOXING CLUB Mixfight Pattaya
items.content_text: Khao Makok combat school offering Muay Thai, boxing, MMA and jiu-jitsu, with current venue activity and independent event records.

items.title: Sanit Sport Club
items.content_text: Pong fitness facility with a live Maps identity; current programme details require direct confirmation.

items.title: Rage Fight Academy

items.title: Soi Seven MuayThai
items.content_text: Active Muay Thai gym on Jomtien Soi 7, now using the operator name Soi Seven MuayThai.

items.title: FIGHT EVO360
items.content_text: Muay Thai gym with wrestling, strength, yoga, open gym and children's sessions; facility hours are published but class times require confirmation.

items.title: Sitpholek Institute of Muay Thai Techniques
items.content_text: Active Khao Talo Muay Thai gym with a confirmed phone and location but no current public tariff or class timetable.

items.title: Jungle Gym Pattaya (former CrossFit Pattaya affiliate)
items.content_text: Functional-fitness gym with published class windows whose former CrossFit affiliate listing is now marked departed.

items.title: Tony's Fitness Group
items.content_text: South Pattaya Third Road weight-training gym with round-the-clock listing hours.

items.title: Universe Gym
items.content_text: Active Welcome Town fitness and bodybuilding gym with a contact-first tariff.

items.title: Fitz Club — Racquets, Health & Fitness
items.content_text: Royal Cliff sports club with gym, pool, tennis, squash, table tennis and a convertible multipurpose court; day visitors are welcome.

items.title: Anytime Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: One record covering separate Again Pattaya and Bukit Point clubs, both with 24-hour member access and branch-specific unanswered pricing questions.

items.title: Fitness 7 Pattaya
items.content_text: Twenty-four-hour central Pattaya gym with a large mixed-equipment floor, boxing ring, functional area and branch-wide published rates.

items.title: SUN Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: Three-branch Pattaya fitness group whose operator pages confirm one-card member access across Buakhao, Pratamnak and Naklua.

items.title: Cross Pattaya Pratamnak — Cloud Club
items.content_text: Hotel wellness amenity with published Cloud Club hours, saltwater-pool hours and no current public non-resident day pass.

items.title: Manhattan Pattaya Fitness Centre
items.content_text: Manhattan Pattaya hotel gym in the ground-floor pool area, open by reservation.

items.title: Ashtanga Yoga Pattaya
items.content_text: Ashtanga yoga studio at Royal Hill Condotel whose operator asks visitors to confirm the current schedule and prices.

items.title: ONE-D YOGA PATTAYA
items.content_text: Yoga studio in Wong Amat with split morning and evening operating periods on most days.

items.title: Nok Yoga
items.content_text: Active Nong Prue yoga page offering health-focused and therapeutic movement instruction; book directly for the current schedule.

items.title: Balance Yoga Studio Pattaya
items.content_text: Pratamnak condominium studio offering yoga plus separate sound-healing and nail-board wellness sessions.

items.title: Siam Country Club Pattaya
items.content_text: Four-course Pattaya golf operation with current visitor green fees, mandatory individual carts and required caddies.

items.title: Phoenix Gold Golf & Country Club
items.content_text: Huai Yai golf club with three nine-hole loops and published standard green fees.

items.title: Burapha Golf Club
items.content_text: Operating 36-hole golf complex in Bo Win, Si Racha.

items.title: Treasure Hill Golf Club
items.content_text: Ban Bueng 18-hole, par-72 golf course with daily Maps hours, a pro shop and contact-first green fees.

items.title: Chee Chan Golf Resort
items.content_text: 18-hole Na Jomtien championship course with a dated 2026 public rate card, driving range and full golf-club facilities.
